notes: Reviewed effective specifications for the Morey-Saint-Denis and Chambolle-Musigny Grand Cru AOCs. The five red-only AOCs use a conservative 100% Pinot Noir positive path; accessory white varieties remain restricted to mixed vineyard plantings. Musigny is represented by separate white and red variants under its current specification as modified in 2013. Conditional white-Musigny fermentable-sugar relief to 4 g/L is fail-closed at the unconditional 3 g/L ceiling until the acidity condition is represented.

specs.notes: Conservative 100% Pinot Noir positive path. Accessory white varieties remain mixed-planting exceptions, not ordinary blend choices.
Clos de Tart differs from the neighboring red Grand Cru cohort by retaining a 35 hL/ha normal yield and requiring manual harvest. Conservative 100% Pinot Noir positive path.
Current Musigny specification as modified in 2013. Conservative 100% Pinot Noir positive path; accessory white varieties remain vineyard mixed-planting exceptions.

Current Musigny white path. The specification permits up to 4 g/L fermentable sugar only under a separate total-acidity condition; the engine uses the unconditional 3 g/L ceiling until that coupled condition is modeled.
